components.name: POST /api/submit-job
components.documentation:
Submit a job request to Slurm.

Args:
    job_request: User's job request
    x_slurm_user_name: Slurm username
    x_slurm_user_token: Slurm JWT token

Returns:
    Slurm API response

components.name: POST /api/submit-hello-world-job
components.documentation:
Submit a hello world job with minimal configuration.

Args:
    partition: Slurm partition to use
    x_slurm_user_name: Slurm username (from header)
    x_slurm_user_token: Slurm JWT token (from header)

Returns:
    Slurm API response

components.name: POST /api/submit-container-job
components.documentation:
Submit a containerized job request using Apptainer.

Args:
    container_request: Container job configuration
    x_slurm_user_name: Slurm username
    x_slurm_user_token: Slurm JWT token

Returns:
    Slurm API response

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the container request is invalid or Slurm API call fails
